valorant.headline: Fan-made Valorant data explorer with live player lookup and interactive tools
valorant.problem: I wanted a Valorant tool that combined game data with real player stats, no backend of my own, while respecting third-party API rate limits and Riot's fan project rules.
valorant.solution: React + Vite SPA with agent, weapon, map and bundle browsing, an interactive damage calculator, and a player lookup that aggregates stats from the last 10 games. The main technical challenge was consuming two third-party APIs with no backend, managing rate limits through a shared throttle across routes.

frakt24.description: Enterprise TMS (Transportation Management System). Multi-module, multi-tenant SaaS platform focused on route planning, asset management, fuel and CO₂ emissions control, and hardware integrations (Mapon GPS, tachograph).
frakt24.highlight1: Designed and built the product's financial module, a per-route profitability system that aggregates revenue and cost streams in real time. It uses bcmath for finance-grade precision in floating-point math.
frakt24.highlight2: Coordinated a cross-repo feature spanning Laravel backend, admin UI, and Flutter mobile. Authored the shared design spec that served as a strict contract between the three streams, with dynamic opt-in activation per tenant.
frakt24.highlight3: Built the CO₂ emissions tracking engine compliant with GLEC Framework v3.2 and ISO 14083 (CSRD-ready), with a hardened audit trail tying every calculation to its official emission factor source.
frakt24.highlight4: Designed an auth-agnostic service layer that unifies web (session auth) and mobile (Firebase Bearer tokens) consumption. Guaranteed multi-entity data integrity via DB transactions and native HTTP Idempotency-Key support on incoming requests.
